source_refs.note: Roman Urdu overview of antiviral and antiretroviral drugs (PDF 212).

blocks.text: Antiviral aur antiretroviral dawaen bacteria ke bajaye viruses ke khilaf kaam karti hain. Antiretroviral dawaen antivirals ka aik khaas group hain.

blocks.alt: Bara neela oval, antiviral drugs, hepatitis, influenza aur herpes viruses ke liye, ke andar chhota surkh oval, antiretroviral drugs, jo HIV jaise retroviruses ka ilaaj karti hain. Note: retroviruses ka genome RNA hai aur reverse transcriptase use karte hain, aur sab antiretrovirals antivirals hain lekin sab antivirals antiretrovirals nahi.
blocks.caption: Antiretrovirals antivirals ka hissa hain (is topic ke liye asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Antiviral dawaen viruses ko jism mein barhne aur afzaish se rok kar virus infections ka ilaaj karti hain; yeh hepatitis, influenza aur herpes jaise viruses ke khilaf kaam karti hain. Antiretroviral dawaen antivirals ka khaas group hain jo HIV jaise retroviruses ke liye hain, yaani aise viruses jin ka genetic maadda RNA hai aur jo enzyme reverse transcriptase se afzaish karte hain; yeh immune system ki madad karti aur HIV ko barhne se rokti hain. Is liye har antiretroviral antiviral hai, lekin har antiviral antiretroviral nahi.

blocks.explanation: Nahi. Sab antiretrovirals antivirals hain, lekin antivirals mein ghair retroviruses, jaise influenza aur herpes viruses, ki dawaen bhi shamil hain.

items: Antivirals viruses par; antiretrovirals retroviruses ke liye antivirals.
